reportMetadata.scope: Independent technical audit of P3 exit criteria vs. actual implementation

executiveSummary.overallAssessment: P3 architecture, API specification, and design docs are complete (100%). Backend implementation covers only Auth (T-601, T-602) and Vendor onboarding (partial T-701). Critical gaps: No MongoDB persistence (InMemory repos), no Product/Order/Cart/Payment/Search/Review/Coupon/Invoice/Admin modules, frontend tests failing (7 failures), no E2E tests, no CI/CD pipeline execution. 28 P4 tasks blocked by MAX_AUTHORIZED_PHASE=3 gate.
blockersForP4: No real MongoDB persistence - InMemoryPersonRepository/VendorRepository only
Frontend tests failing (7 failures: authStore + App.test.tsx)
No Playwright E2E tests (tests/e2e directory missing)
CI/CD pipeline defined in docs but not executed/validated
Stripe Connect test mode validation pending (Q-011/Q-012 PARTIALLY_RESOLVED)

personDomain.details: person.domain.ts matches MongoDB design (T-301): Person entity with MainInfo (CPF XOR CNPJ per CD-007), ContactInfo (email/phone/whatsapp), Address, PersonRole enum (CONSUMER/VENDOR/ADMIN), InMemoryPersonRepository. CPF/CNPJ validation with check digits implemented.
gaps: Uses InMemoryPersonRepository instead of MongoDB/Mongoose persistence
ID generation uses timestamp+random (not UUID as in OpenAPI schemas)
No schema validation / Mongoose model defined

authModule.details: auth/ module complete with JWT + RBAC per CD-010, CD-004, CD-059: credential.domain.ts (bcrypt, password strength), auth.service.ts (register/login/refreshToken, JWT RS256-ready), auth.middleware.ts (Bearer token verification, requireRole/requireConsumer/requireVendor/requireAdmin), auth.routes.ts (/register, /login, /refresh). 158 backend tests passing.
gaps: Uses HS256 (jwt.sign default) instead of RS256 as specified in security.md
Refresh token not stored hashed in DB (only in-memory via JWT payload)
No token revocation on logout/password change
JWT secret from config (HS256 compatible) - no RSA key pair generated

vendorModule.details: vendor/ module exists with vendor.domain.ts (Vendor entity, VendorStatus, InMemoryVendorRepository), vendor.service.ts (onboardVendor, getVendorById, getVendorByPersonId, suspendVendor, updateVendor), vendor.routes.ts (/onboard, /me GET, /me PATCH). Ownership check on PATCH /me (CD-059). Auto-publish on registration (CD-041). Commission from global config (CD-045).
gaps: Uses InMemoryVendorRepository instead of MongoDB
Missing: Product CRUD, Coupon CRUD, Vendor Dashboard metrics (T-701 partially done)
No vendor suspension by admin, no vendor deletion

configValidation.details: config/index.ts validates MONGO_URI, REDIS_URL, ELASTICSEARCH_URL, JWT_SECRET in production (validateRequiredInProduction). CORS origin parsing with wildcard prohibition in prod. commissionPct from env. validateConfig() enforces production values not using defaults.
gaps: No validation that MONGO_URI is a valid MongoDB connection string format
No validation for Stripe keys (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) - required for P4e

missingEndpoints: Checkout: Create Order + OVGs, stock validation (T-902)
Payment: Stripe Connect integration, webhooks, idempotency (T-1001)
Split Payment / Commission: Per OVG transfer, vendor payout (T-1002, T-1003)
Refund: Initiate, approve, process, commission reversal (T-1004)
Search: ES query DSL, facets, pagination (T-802)
Invoice: PDF generation, S3 storage, link on Order (T-1103)
Wallet/Transaction: Vendor & marketplace wallets, ledger (CD-030, CD-031)

schemaAlignment.details: OpenAPI schemas use UUID format for IDs (e.g., Person.id format: uuid). Implementation uses timestamp-random string IDs (generateId()). Person schema in OpenAPI has 'document' field (CPF/CNPJ formatted), implementation has mainInfo.taxIdType + taxIdValue. Vendor schema matches well. Product/Order/Cart schemas exist in OpenAPI but no implementation.
mismatches: ID format: OpenAPI expects UUID, implementation uses custom ID
Person: OpenAPI has 'document' string, implementation has mainInfo {taxIdType, taxIdValue}
Roles: OpenAPI uses lowercase enum [customer, vendor, admin], implementation uses UPPERCASE [CONSUMER, VENDOR, ADMIN]
No Mongoose models to enforce schema at persistence layer

backendMd.details: docs/architecture/backend.md defines 22 modules. Implemented: auth, person, vendor (3/22). Missing: product, category, cart, checkout, order, payment, review, coupon, invoice, wallet, common. Cross-cutting concerns documented but not implemented (RFC 7807 errors partially, structured JSON logging not implemented, domain events not implemented).
backendMd.techStackMismatch: Doc says Fastify, implementation uses Express

frontendMd.details: docs/architecture/frontend.md defines React 18 + Vite, TanStack Query, Zustand, Tailwind, Playwright. Frontend has: React 18, Vite, React Router v6, Zustand (authStore), Vitest, Playwright configured. Missing: TanStack Query (not installed), Tailwind (not installed), API client generated from OpenAPI, feature folders structure partially matches (auth, home, shared).
gaps: TanStack Query not in package.json
Tailwind CSS not in package.json
No API client generation from OpenAPI
State management: Zustand for auth only, no cart/UI state

infrastructureMd.details: docs/architecture/infrastructure.md defines AWS ECS Fargate, DocumentDB, OpenSearch, ElastiCache, S3, CloudFront, ALB, VPC, Secrets Manager. Root docker-compose.yml exists with backend, frontend, mongo, redis, elasticsearch. Matches dev environment spec (CD-053).
gaps: No Terraform/CDK IaC
No AWS deployment configs
Secrets management: docker-compose uses plain env vars, not Secrets Manager

cicdMd.details: docs/architecture/ci-cd.md defines GitHub Actions pipeline with lint, test:unit, test:api, build, scan, deploy:staging, deploy:prod for backend; similar for frontend. No GitHub Actions workflow files found in repo.
gaps: No .github/workflows/ directory
No CI pipeline execution evidence

observabilityMd.details: docs/architecture/observability.md defines structured JSON logging, Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing, CloudWatch/X-Ray/Tempo. Implementation: console.error in error handler only. No structured logging, no metrics endpoint, no tracing.
gaps: No structured JSON logger (pino/winston)
No Prometheus metrics exposition (/metrics)
No OpenTelemetry instrumentation

securityMd.details: docs/architecture/security.md defines JWT RS256, Argon2id, Helmet, CSP, rate limiting, RFC 7807, TLS 1.3, secrets rotation, audit logging. Implementation: Helmet (yes), CORS (yes), JWT HS256 (not RS256), bcrypt (not Argon2id), no rate limiting middleware, no RFC 7807 error format (custom error format), no audit logging.
gaps: JWT algorithm: HS256 vs RS256
Password hashing: bcrypt vs Argon2id
No rate limiting (Redis-backed sliding window)
No RFC 7807 Problem Details format
No audit logging
CSP header not configured in Helmet

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: InMemory repositories lose all data on restart. No transaction support, no durability. Concurrent operations not protected (race conditions on email/taxId uniqueness).
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Implement MongoDB persistence with proper indexes and transactions before P4

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: HS256 JWT vulnerable to key confusion attacks. bcrypt with low rounds (4 in test) not production-grade. No rate limiting enables brute force. No audit logging for compliance.
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Implement RS256, Argon2id, rate limiting, audit logging before production

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: OpenAPI schemas (UUID, lowercase roles) diverge from implementation (custom ID, UPPERCASE roles). Will cause frontend-backend integration failures.
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Align ID generation to UUID and role enum casing before frontend integration

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: Stripe Connect Separate Charges and Transfers flow complex (manual transfer reversal on refund, async PIX/Boleto handling, idempotency keys). Without test mode validation, production deployment will fail.
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Execute test mode validation (MP-07 Stage D) with real Stripe test credentials before P4e

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: Frontend tests failing, missing TanStack Query/Tailwind, no API client generation. Frontend cannot reliably consume backend APIs.
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Fix frontend tests, install dependencies, generate API client before P4 frontend tasks

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: No automated testing, linting, security scanning on push. Defects can reach staging/production undetected.
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Create GitHub Actions workflows before team collaboration scales

risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.description: MAX_AUTHORIZED_PHASE=3 prevents autonomous P4 execution. Human authorization required per project rules.
risksOfProceedingToP4WithoutResolution.mitigation: Obtain explicit human approval to proceed to P4
